notes: Port of tool-schema.mjs, re2-pattern.mjs, array-items.mjs and tool-budget.mjs from packages/agy-cli. Byte-faithful apart from the TS types and the `unknown`-typed signatures; scripts/ad-hoc/agy-schema-diff.mjs validates the port against the upstream .mjs files.
